scope: Chromium localhost, real web/ota.js and local JSZip 3.10.1, CRC-32 1.2.2, web-bluetooth-dfu 1.2.1; simulated GATT only; no device flashed
package: Generated ZIP with Nordic Secure DFU application manifest, 3-byte init packet and 90-byte application image

success.status: Firmware update finished. The device restarts into the application; reconnect to send frames again.

cancel_during_firmware.status: Cancellation requested. Close the device chooser if it is open; the device may remain in the bootloader and need another update.

resume_crc_retry_smoke.scope: Same local libraries and simulated GATT; 3-byte init and 60-byte firmware; 20-byte objects
resume_crc_retry_smoke.firmware_select_offset_20: Resumed with two 20-byte firmware writes and update completed
resume_crc_retry_smoke.firmware_object_checksum_mismatch: DFU failed: DFU checksum mismatch.; busy cleared
resume_crc_retry_smoke.retry_after_checksum_failure: Fresh chooser and new DFU instance; three 20-byte firmware writes; update completed
resume_crc_retry_smoke.vendor_limitation: Firmware SELECT does not call checkCrc, so the vendor library does not validate the reported resume prefix CRC at selection.

network_probe.public_control_curl_headers: 302 github.com to release-assets.githubusercontent.com, then 200; observed responses lacked Access-Control-Allow-Origin
network_probe.limitation: No target asset was available for its own download or CORS probe; public control demonstrates that metadata API access does not guarantee browser binary access.
